annotations.text:
Mobile screens for mdhygiene.in — 390px wide.
Desktop stays exactly as built; these are the phone-only layouts.

Same tokens as the live site: Schibsted Grotesk, navy #123A5C, blue #1E62B0, pink #E4779F, cream #FBF6F2, border #F0E4DC, 16px cards, 8px buttons.

What is deliberately different from desktop:

• Brands + featured products become swipe rails instead of stacked full-width cards
• Products list is a compact image-left row — four fit a screen instead of one
• Certifications drop to a 2x2 preview grid on home, thumbnail-left rows on the page
• Sticky Call / Get a quote bar (proposal — not on the site yet)
